resources.string: Messages
Instagram messages, passed on by Throwback. Tap to open the chat in Throwback.
Likes, comments and follows
The Instagram notification types you switched on in Settings → Connect → Instagram.
Protection
The small, silent notification Android needs while Throwback watches for the Instagram app.
Protection off
Tells you when Android stopped Throwback\'s watch over the Instagram app.
New message
Missed call
New activity
Throwback is protecting you
Opening the Instagram app brings you back to Throwback, except for calls and posting.
Instagram app not blocked right now
Throwback can\'t see calls while its notification access is disconnected, so it lets the Instagram app open. It is asking Android to reconnect.
Instagram guard is off
Android stopped it. Tap to turn it back on.
A permission it needs was turned off. Tap to turn it back on.
Use Throwback instead
The Instagram app is only for calls and posting. Taking you back…
